capacity_note: Hintze Hall 270 seated / 550 drinks; Harbour View Room 1 (rooftop) 120 seated / 200; Westpac Long Gallery 80 seated / 150 (no amplified music or dancing); Wild Planet 60 seated / 200; Harbour View Room 2 50 seated / 100.
price_note: No prices published. The Fresh Collective is the exclusive caterer.
editorial_summary: A sandstone natural history museum in the city with five hire spaces, from a grand central hall to a rooftop room with harbour views and a gallery lined with animal displays. Ceremonies and receptions are both offered, though the caterer is fixed and the long gallery bans amplified music and dancing.

address: 2 Murray Street, Darling Harbour, Sydney NSW 2000
capacity_note: Ben Lexcen Terrace 270 seated / 400 cocktail; Lighthouse Gallery 250 / 400; Terrace Room 130 / 250; HMAS Vampire 50 / 120. The caterer's own page lists HarbourWatch North at 650 cocktail. A 2021 brochure gave ceremony capacities of 100 (boardwalk and terrace); current ceremony numbers need confirming.
price_note: No prices published. SRG Hospitality is the in-house caterer; corkage applies to BYO drinks; extra fees for room flips and bars over 200 guests.
editorial_summary: A waterfront museum on Darling Harbour where couples can marry on the boardwalk or terrace and hold the reception in galleries, a rooftop room or on board a decommissioned navy destroyer. Catering runs through an in-house partner. Contacts here are the museum's general line because no current venue-specific number is published.

address: 140 George Street, The Rocks, Sydney NSW 2000
capacity_note: Foundation Hall 100-300 seated / 150-750 cocktail (wedding 100-240); Harbourside Room 100-200 seated / 100-300; Quayside Room 50-120 / 50-200; Sculpture Terrace up to 60 for a wedding.
price_note: No prices published; The Big Group is the exclusive caterer. Couples booking a reception get exclusive in-gallery photo access (extra fee).
editorial_summary: A contemporary art museum on Circular Quay with a former harbour-authority ballroom, two rooftop rooms and a sculpture terrace, all facing the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. Couples booking a reception can add private photos among the artworks. Catering is through one exclusive provider.

address: Queens Square, Macquarie Street, Sydney NSW 2000
capacity_note: Southern Courtyard marquee: 250 long banquet / 210 round tables / 500 cocktail, including the wedding party. Ceremony only inside your own marquee for cocktail receptions; sit-down dinners need an offsite ceremony.
price_note: No prices published; a wedding package is on request, hire is charged over three days (set-up, event, pack-down) plus a bond. Pearl Catering is the on-site partner; Gold Licence caterers by application.
editorial_summary: A Georgian sandstone barracks museum on Macquarie Street with a courtyard where a marquee reception is built for up to 500 standing or 250 seated. Evenings only, and a seated dinner needs the ceremony held elsewhere, such as at The Mint.

capacity_note: Ceremony: 100 in the Saloon, 40 in the Dining Room. Hall and Saloon 40 seated (oval banquet) / 100 cocktail; Cellar 36 seated / 40 cocktail. All events finish by 10:30pm; upstairs wedding room is not accessible.
price_note: Hire fee not published; overtime from $465 inc GST per hour. 50% deposit within 14 days. Gold Licence caterer panel; BYO alcohol not allowed; florals and styling need approval a month ahead.
editorial_summary: An 1830s harbourside house museum with a domed saloon and a sweeping staircase, hosting small ceremonies and receptions of up to about 100 guests. Strict heritage rules apply: no BYO alcohol, no open flames, approved caterers only, and a finish by 10:30pm.
A colonial-era mint run by Museums of History NSW, with a courtyard and lawn ceremony area for up to 180 guests and a wet-weather bar for 100.
A Gothic Revival house museum with gardens, run by Museums of History NSW and booked through the same venue team as The Mint.
The state art gallery, offering a restaurant and function space, Sydney Modern Hall for up to about 250, and short exclusive ceremonies alongside a reception.

A heritage library whose historic Mitchell building hosts weddings in the Friends Room (a former reading room) and Gallery Room; catering is through an exclusive contractor and wedding photography is outside opening hours.

vendor_name: Penrith Regional Gallery & The Lewers Bequest
capacity_note: 100 sit-down or 120 canapes; minimum 40 guests. Private hire 4:00pm-10:30pm with a 3-hour minimum; bar closes about 9:30pm.
price_note: Catering packages from $60 per person (cafe is the required caterer, no BYO, cake service $4pp); photography access $220 for 4 hours; no separate hire fee listed.
editorial_summary: Two acres of heritage gardens beside the Nepean River, filled with sculpture and mosaics, with a garden ceremony and a covered sandstone-and-cedar canopy reception beside a regional gallery. Private evening hire for 40 to about 100 guests, with the on-site cafe as the required caterer.

capacity_note: Venue pages disagree: up to 130 seated / 180 cocktail on the weddings page, 120 / 200 in the FAQ; Garden Room up to 50. Lower figures stored.
price_note: Packages by enquiry; weekend 10% surcharge. Council garden ceremony hire is $620 for 2 hours (GST incl., valid to 30 June 2027) plus staffing $87 per hour and $215 cleaning.
editorial_summary: A restaurant and reception space inside a regional arts centre built around an Art Deco cottage and gardens, with a garden ceremony option and exclusive use on the wedding day. The restaurant is the caterer; the council hires the gardens for ceremonies separately.

capacity_note: Performance Studio: up to 180 seated (tiered bank lists 200 seats) / 350 standing. Sculpture Gardens hireable by the half or full day, capacity not stated. Hire window 8:30am-4:30pm unless extended for a fee.
price_note: Fees are in the council 2026-27 fees and charges PDF; amounts not read.
editorial_summary: A council-run contemporary arts centre whose air-conditioned performance studio and sculpture gardens can be hired for functions, with the studio page naming weddings. Daytime hire by default, so it suits a lunch or afternoon celebration; ceremony and catering rules are not published.

vendor_name: Barnet Long Room at Customs House
capacity_note: About 200 guests in total across four linked spaces (balcony, boardroom, pre-function lounge, main hall); seated/standing split not stated.
price_note: Minimum hire: $2,272 standard (8 hours), $2,650 evening (5 hours), $1,700 half day (4 hours). Food and drink must come from the caterer nominated by the City of Sydney; no BYO.
editorial_summary: A first-floor function room in the heritage Customs House above Circular Quay, listed by the City of Sydney with weddings among permitted uses. It has permanent staging at each end and harbour views, but all catering goes through the council's nominated caterer. Ceremony rules are not stated.

A 13-hectare colonial house-and-farm museum run by Museums of History NSW. Ceremonies of up to 80 guests are held on the carriage loop, in the summerhouse or the Stables, with approved Gold Licence caterers only and heritage rules on red wine and menus.
